caption: Night 1. The killers meet. Nobody dies tonight.
Gemma is a killer, and the officer was shown her face. She knows.
Haiku is the other killer. Nobody knows about him.
Day 1. Haiku picks a fight over nothing, and the table turns on him.
Sol is the officer.
He says it out loud.
The hidden killer has to stop him.
Three-way tie: two votes each.
One line each before the runoff.
The runoff.
Gemma was a killer. The officer told the truth.
Night 2. Gemma is out, but she still whispers to her partner.
The doctor guessed right. Sol lives, and his night check finds Haiku.
Day 2. Sol names the second killer.
The killer has one move left.
He claims the same badge.
But Sol's first call already came true.
The town asks why Haiku waited.
4 to 1.
Haiku was the other killer.
The officer told the truth twice. This time the town listened.
